views.text: In February 2025, Equity Mates said Project Stargate, involving Oracle, OpenAI, SoftBank and a UAE fund, aimed to spend $100 billion in 2025 on AI infrastructure, illustrating SoftBank’s role in massive AI build-out spending where hundreds of billions were locked in from major players.

episode.title: Picks and shovel AI stocks, investing in cyclical stocks & Chris Judd joins the show

views.text: In October 2024, Equity Mates reported OpenAI’s round valued it at $157 billion, raising $6.6 billion, with SoftBank investing about $500 million, and flagged how heavy chip costs and forecast losses framed SoftBank’s backing despite rapid revenue growth.

episode.title: How the US election will impact your portfolio, Owen Rask reveals his portfolio & shackles are off at OpenAI

views.text: In September 2023, Equity Mates said SoftBank was one of the largest owners of a company IPOing at about a $52 billion valuation, saying the listing timing rode a hot market and could crystallise value from SoftBank’s stake.

episode.title: What next for QANTAS, Andrew Page on Reporting Season & the ESG debate continues
